synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC. Every number and rule here is invented for a demo. It does not describe any real wallet, bank or regulator.

basic.upgrade_path: Complete KYC-01, KYC-02 and KYC-03 to become verified.

verified.upgrade_path: Complete KYC-04 and KYC-05 to become premium.

rules.text: Each tier has a maximum amount per single transaction (basic 500 LC, verified 3000 LC, premium 20000 LC).
Each tier has a daily sending limit (basic 1000 LC, verified 8000 LC, premium 50000 LC). It resets at 00:00 UTC every day.

Each tier has a monthly sending limit (basic 4000 LC, verified 30000 LC, premium 200000 LC). The month is a calendar month, not a rolling 30 days. It resets at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month.
Each tier has a cap on the number of transfers per calendar month (basic 20, verified 60, premium 200). The count restarts on the first day of each calendar month.
Each tier has a wallet balance cap (basic 2000 LC, verified 15000 LC, premium 100000 LC). An incoming payment that would pass the cap is declined and returned to the sender.
When a sending limit is reached, new transfers are blocked until the limit resets. Receiving money still works, up to the balance cap.

A temporary limit increase is open to verified and premium users only. It can be requested once per calendar month in the app. It raises the monthly sending limit (LIM-03) by up to 25 percent for 7 days. It does not change the per transaction limit, the daily limit, the transfer count cap or the balance cap. Basic users cannot request it.
Transfer fees: basic 1.5 percent with a 2 LC minimum, verified 0.8 percent with a 1 LC minimum, premium 0.3 percent with a 25 LC maximum.
If a payment fails, its fee is reversed together with the amount. Fees on completed payments are not refunded.
Basic to verified, step 1: confirm your phone number by typing the 6-digit code the app sends you, inside the app.
Basic to verified, step 2: upload a photo of a national ID card or a passport. Driving permits are not accepted.
Basic to verified, step 3: take a live selfie in the app. Review takes 1 to 2 business days.
Verified to premium, step 1: upload proof of address dated within the last 90 days.
Verified to premium, step 2: fill in the source of funds form in the app. Review takes 3 to 5 business days.
Common rejection reasons: blurry image, expired ID, name does not match the account, selfie does not match the ID photo.

After a rejection the user can resubmit right after fixing the problem. A user gets at most 3 attempts in a 30 day window, which starts at the first attempt. After the third rejection the user is locked from KYC for 14 days and can contact a human agent about the case. When the lock ends, the attempt count restarts at zero and a new 30 day window begins with 3 new attempts.
A payment shows one of three statuses: Pending, Completed or Failed. Pending can last up to 24 hours.
If money was taken but the payment shows Failed, it is reversed automatically to its source. Wallet balance: within 1 business day. Linked bank account: within 5 business days.
If a payment is still Pending after 24 hours, or a reversal is late, the user should open the payment and tap Report a problem.
PocketLoop does not refund Completed payments to merchants. The user should ask the merchant first. If the merchant does not help, the user can open a dispute within 30 days of the payment.
A dispute is reviewed within 10 business days and ends in one of two outcomes: upheld or rejected. The outcome is not promised in advance, and the bot must not predict it.

If a dispute is upheld, the payment amount is returned to the user's wallet balance, not to a bank account, within 2 business days of the decision. The transfer fee is not returned. If a dispute is rejected, there is no refund, and the user can appeal once within 7 days by adding new evidence. Disputes cover payments to merchants only, not transfers to other people.
Money sent to the wrong person by the user cannot be pulled back by PocketLoop. The user can ask the receiver to send it back.
Support and the support bot never ask for a one time code, PIN, password or full card number.
If a user has shared a code, PIN or password with anyone, the bot should tell them to change their PIN in the app and tap Report a problem right away.
The bot cannot see balances, payments or account details, and cannot change anything on an account.
For account specific problems, the bot sends the user to Report a problem in the app. A human agent replies within 1 business day.
The bot must not state a fact, number, date or promise that is not in this fact sheet. If it does not know, it says so and points to Report a problem.
